Name: The Fractured Vestibule
Description: This is where it begins—or ends again. The walls remember your name.
Effect: Starting location for Rob and Cait.

Name: The Shifting Gallery
Description: Portraits rearrange when you blink. Each face resembles someone you failed.
Effect: Reveals an adjacent tile each visit.

Name: The Drowned Room
Description: Water up to your knees. Something colder clings to your ankles.
Effect: Lose 1 Sanity on entry, +1 Sanity on exit.

Name: The Clockwork Fissure
Description: Gears buried in stone tick out the seconds you’ve lost.
Effect: +1 Hope if you stay a full turn.

Name: The Maw of Sleep
Description: Even your thoughts feel heavy here. Time slows to a crawl.
Effect: Skip a turn to gain +2 Sanity.

Name: The Static Hall
Description: Buzzing walls echo secrets you've never told anyone.
Effect: Gain 1 random item, lose 1 Sanity.

Name: The Hollow Spine
Description: A corridor of vertebrae, and you're the marrow.
Effect: +1 Hope if you leave an item behind.

Name: The Stained Bell Tower
Description: Each ring peels skin from time’s body.
Effect: Randomly affects either Hope or Sanity.

Name: The Eclipsed Chapel
Description: The light here doesn’t shine—it watches.
Effect: +1 Hope if visited with Cait.

Name: The Ember Basin
Description: Ash falls like snow. Your lungs remember a fire that never happened.
Effect: +1 Hope, -1 Sanity.

Name: The Choir Trench
Description: Every step echoes a hymn sung backward.
Effect: -1 Hope if you hum.

Name: The Bone Parlor
Description: Furniture carved from memory. It creaks in your mother’s voice.
Effect: +1 Sanity if alone.

Name: The Silted Orchard
Description: Fruit grows in the dirt, not the branches.
Effect: Trade 1 item for +1 Hope.

Name: The Gallery of Unmade Things
Description: Each sculpture screams when looked at directly.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain rare item.

Name: The Buried Atrium
Description: Dust and rot frame what once was joy.
Effect: +1 Hope if you rest here.

Name: The Haunting Fold
Description: The ceiling lowers when you're silent. And rises when you lie.
Effect: -1 Sanity if no dialogue spoken.

Name: The Shatterpond
Description: Reflections show you leaving. Alone.
Effect: Only one player can recover here (+1 Sanity).

Name: The Archive of Screams
Description: Scrolls roll themselves shut when you listen too closely.
Effect: Gain item: Deaf Candle.

Name: The Threshing Frame
Description: It grinds memory into meaning.
Effect: Choose: +1 Sanity or +1 Hope, lose 1 Sanity.

Name: The Flayed Sanctum
Description: Walls peeled to nerve endings. They scream when touched.
Effect: -1 Sanity every turn spent.

Name: The Chamber of Guilt
Description: An endless room lined with mirrors that only reflect the past.
Effect: -1 Hope if Cait is absent.

Name: The Hung Staircase
Description: Each step is a choice you didn’t make. Each creak is a consequence.
Effect: +1 Hope if Rob and Cait are both present.

Name: The Lantern Field
Description: Glowing orbs float like memories trying to leave.
Effect: Gain 1 revealed tile of your choice.

Name: The Shrike's Gallery
Description: Hooks hang from the ceiling. They twitch when you speak.
Effect: -1 Sanity if you used an item this turn.

Name: The Final Gate
Description: It doesn’t open. It consumes. But maybe, just maybe, it lets go.
Effect: Exit card. Only available when both Rob and Cait are present with 3+ Hope and Sanity.

Name: Sanctuary Node
Description: A rare pocket of calm hums with gentle static.
Effect: Resting here restores +1 Sanity, no Hope loss.

Name: Hall of Broken Echoes
Description: Every sound fractures into shards that cut the mind.
Effect: Speaking here causes 1 Sanity loss per turn.

Name: Glass Field
Description: Fragments crunch underfoot, reflecting endless possibilities.
Effect: When leaving, roll 1d6; on a 1, take 1 Sanity damage.

Name: Clattering Archive
Description: Files scatter themselves like startled birds.
Effect: Reveal all adjacent tiles when uncovered.

Name: Blood Loop
Description: A track worn red from endless pacing.
Effect: End two turns here in a row to gain 1 Sanity but lose 1 Hope.

Name: Static Well
Description: A deep pit crackles with glimpses of other places.
Effect: Peek at any tile but you cannot move next turn.

Name: Resonance Chamber
Description: Walls vibrate with the frequency of companionship.
Effect: If both players are here, gain +1 Hope.

Name: Abyssal Engine
Description: A grotesque device churns, hungry for offerings.
Effect: Use an item for +2 Hope, then discard this tile.

Name: Twilight Chamber
Description: Fading light distorts every action into uncertainty.
Effect: All rolls +1 difficulty; success grants +1 Sanity.

Name: Dust Archive
Description: Stacks of brittle paper crumble at your touch.
Effect: Reveal nearest unrevealed tile; if it's a Location, gain 1 Hope.

Name: Fragment Corridor
Description: Walls shift disjointedly, scattering your focus.
Effect: Sanity checks are rolled twice; use the worse result.

Name: Eye of the Storm
Description: Calm emptiness sits at the center of swirling chaos.
Effect: End a turn here alone to gain 1 Sanity but lose 1 Hope.

Name: Corrupter's Trace
Description: Distorted footprints hint at something stalking you.
Effect: After leaving, roll 1d6; on 6, spawn a random Encounter next turn.

Name: Harmonic Node
Description: Soft tones resonate, strengthening shared resolve.
Effect: Each turn here lowers next turn's Sanity loss by 1.

Name: Echo Node
Description: Twin beacons resonate across the void.
Effect: Players here may trade with a partner on another Echo Node.
